          {unit}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="h-80 sm:h-96 w-full touch-pan-y">
        <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%">
          {chartType === "bar" && itemKeys.length > 0 ? (
            <BarChart
              data={chartData}
              margin={{ top: 10, right: 15, left: 10, bottom: 20 }}
            >
              <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" stroke="#f1f5f9" vertical={false} />
              <XAxis
                dataKey="year"
                tickLine={false}
                axisLine={{ stroke: "#cbd5e1" }}
                tick={{ fill: "#64748b", fontSize: 11 }}
                dy={6}
              />
              <YAxis
                width={70}
                tickLine={false}
                axisLine={false}
                tick={{ fill: "#64748b", fontSize: 11 }}
                domain={[0, "auto"]}
                tickFormatter={formatSpanishNumber}
              />
              <Tooltip content={<CustomTooltipContent unit={unit} />} />
              {itemKeys.map((k, idx) => {
                const color =
                  ITEM_COLORS[k] || `hsl(${(idx * 43) % 360}, 65%, 45%)`;
                const isSelected = selectedKey === k;
                const isDimmed = selectedKey !== null && !isSelected;

                return (
                  <Bar
                    key={k}
                    dataKey={k}
                    stackId="a"
                    fill={color}
                    fillOpacity={isDimmed ? 0.2 : 1}
                    maxBarSize={42}
                    radius={
                      idx === itemKeys.length - 1 ? [6, 6, 0, 0] : [0, 0, 0, 0]
                    }
                  />
                );
              })}
            </BarChart>
          ) : (
            <LineChart
              data={chartData.length ? chartData : series}
              margin={{ top: 10, right: 15, left: 10, bottom: 20 }}
            >
              <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" stroke="#f1f5f9" vertical={false} />
              <XAxis
                dataKey={chartData.length ? "year" : "date"}
                tickLine={false}
                axisLine={{ stroke: "#cbd5e1" }}
                tick={{ fill: "#64748b", fontSize: 11 }}
                dy={6}
              />
              <YAxis
                width={70}
                tickLine={false}
                axisLine={false}
                tick={{ fill: "#64748b", fontSize: 11 }}
                domain={[0, "auto"]}
                tickFormatter={formatSpanishNumber}
              />
              <Tooltip content={<CustomTooltipContent unit={unit} />} />
              {itemKeys.length > 0 ? (
                itemKeys.map((k, idx) => {
                  const color =
                    ITEM_COLORS[k] || `hsl(${(idx * 43) % 360}, 65%, 45%)`;
                  const isSelected = selectedKey === k;
                  const isDimmed = selectedKey !== null && !isSelected;

                  return (
                    <Line
                      key={k}
                      type="monotone"
                      dataKey={k}
                      name={formatLabel(k)}
                      stroke={color}
                      strokeWidth={isSelected ? 4 : isDimmed ? 1 : 2.5}
                      strokeOpacity={isDimmed ? 0.2 : 1}
                      dot={isSelected ? { r: 5, fill: color } : false}
                      activeDot={{ r: 6, strokeWidth: 2 }}
                    />
                  );
                })
              ) : (
                <Line
                  type="monotone"
                  dataKey="value"
                  stroke="#2563eb"
                  strokeWidth={3}
                  dot={{ r: 4, fill: "#2563eb", stroke: "#ffffff", strokeWidth: 2 }}
                  activeDot={{ r: 7, fill: "#1d4ed8", stroke: "#ffffff", strokeWidth: 2 }}
                />
              )}
            </LineChart>
          )}
        </ResponsiveContainer>
      </div>

      {itemKeys.length > 0 && (
        <div className="space-y-2 border-t border-slate-100 pt-3">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider">
              Leyenda (Haz clic para destacar):
            </span>
            {selectedKey && (
              <button
                onClick={() => setSelectedKey(null)}
                className="text-xs font-semibold text-blue-600 hover:underline"
              >
                Restablecer
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
            {itemKeys.map((k, idx) => {
              const color =
                ITEM_COLORS[k] || `hsl(${(idx * 43) % 360}, 65%, 45%)`;
              const isSelected = selectedKey === k;
              return (
                <button
                  key={k}
                  onClick={() => setSelectedKey(isSelected ? null : k)}
                  className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-medium border transition-all ${
                    isSelected
                      ? "bg-slate-900 text-white border-slate-900 shadow-xs scale-105 font-bold"
                      : "bg-slate-50 text-slate-700 border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-100"
                  }`}
                >
                  <span
                    className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full flex-shrink-0"
                    style={{ backgroundColor: color }}
                  />
                  <span>{formatLabel(k)}</span>
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 text-center">
        Pasa el cursor o toca sobre cualquier punto para consultar el desglose exacto.
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}

// ==========================================
// FILE: components/detail/SourceCard.tsx
// ==========================================

import { ExternalLink, ShieldCheck, Calendar, AlertCircle } from "lucide-react";
import { SourceInfo, TraceableSource } from "@/types";

interface SourceCardProps extends TraceableSource {
  lastUpdated?: string;
  defaultInstitution?: string;
  description?: string;
}

const DEFAULT_INSTITUTION = "Instituto Nacional de Estadística (INE)";

function normalizeSources(source?: SourceInfo, sources?: SourceInfo[]): SourceInfo[] {
  if (sources && sources.length > 0) return sources;
  if (source) return [source];
  return [];
}

function resolveShortName(source: SourceInfo): string {
  return source.shortName || source.title || source.institution || "Ver fuente oficial";
}

function buildSourceKey(source: SourceInfo, fallbackIdx: number): string {
  return `${source.tableId ?? "src"}-${source.period ?? fallbackIdx}-${source.url}`;
}

export default function SourceCard({
  source,
  sources,
  lastUpdated,
  defaultInstitution = DEFAULT_INSTITUTION,
  description,
}: SourceCardProps) {
  const sourceList = normalizeSources(source, sources);

  if (sourceList.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div className="bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded-2xl p-5 shadow-sm space-y-4">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between flex-wrap gap-2">
          <span className="text-[11px] uppercase tracking-wider font-bold text-slate-400 flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <ShieldCheck className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-400" />
            Fuente Oficial de Datos y Trazabilidad
          </span>
        </div>
        <div className="p-5 rounded-xl border border-dashed border-slate-800 bg-slate-950/50 text-center space-y-2">
          <AlertCircle className="w-5 h-5 text-amber-400 mx-auto" />
          <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-white">
            Pendiente de vinculación con tabla oficial
          </p>
          <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-400">
            No hay fuentes oficiales vinculadas a este registro actualmente.
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const uniqueInstitutions = Array.from(
    new Set(sourceList.map((s) => s.institution).filter(Boolean))
  );
  const headerInstitution =
    uniqueInstitutions.length > 1
      ? uniqueInstitutions.join(" / ")
      : sourceList[0]?.institution || defaultInstitution;

  const defaultSubtitle =
    sourceList.length === 1
      ? "Enlace directo a la publicación original para auditar y contrastar la serie histórica oficial:"
      : "Series enlazadas para auditar y contrastar directamente los tramos o registros oficiales que componen este indicador:";
  const subtitleText = description || defaultSubtitle;

  return (
    <div className="bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded-2xl p-5 shadow-sm space-y-4">
      {/* Título único de la sección */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between flex-wrap gap-2">
        <span className="text-[11px] uppercase tracking-wider font-bold text-slate-400 flex items-center gap-1.5">
          <ShieldCheck className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-400" />
          Fuente Oficial de Datos y Trazabilidad
        </span>
      </div>

      <div className="space-y-1">
        <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-white">
          {headerInstitution}
        </p>
        <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">
          {subtitleText}
        </p>
      </div>

      {/* Lista unificada de fuentes que componen la serie */}
      <div className="space-y-3">
        {sourceList.map((s, idx) => {
          const shortName = resolveShortName(s);
          const effectiveLastUpdated = s.lastUpdated ?? lastUpdated;

          return (
            <div
              key={buildSourceKey(s, idx)}
              className="p-4 rounded-xl border transition-all flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-start sm:items-center justify-between gap-4 bg-slate-950/50 border-slate-800 hover:border-slate-700"
            >
              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
                  {uniqueInstitutions.length > 1 && s.institution && (
                    <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-amber-400 bg-amber-950/80 px-2 py-0.5 rounded border border-amber-800/80">
                      {s.institution}
                    </span>
                  )}
                  <span className="text-xs font-bold text-white">
                    {s.title}
                  </span>
                  {s.period && (
                    <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-blue-400 bg-blue-950 px-2 py-0.5 rounded border border-blue-800/80">
                      {s.period}
                    </span>
                  )}
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-3 text-[11px] text-slate-400 flex-wrap">
                  {s.tableId && (
                    <span className="font-mono text-slate-300 font-semibold">
                      Tabla {s.tableId}
                    </span>
                  )}
                  {effectiveLastUpdated && (
                    <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
                      <Calendar className="w-3 h-3 text-slate-500" />
                      Última actualización: {effectiveLastUpdated}
                    </span>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>

              <a
                href={s.url}
                target="_blank"
                rel="noopener noreferrer"
                className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-semibold text-blue-300 hover:text-white bg-blue-950 hover:bg-blue-900 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl transition-colors border border-blue-800/80 shrink-0 w-full sm:w-auto justify-center"
              >
                <span>
                  {shortName}
                  {s.period ? ` (${s.period})` : ""}
                  {s.tableId ? ` · Tabla ${s.tableId}` : ""} ↗
                </span>
                <ExternalLink className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              </a>
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}


// ==========================================
// FILE: components/detail/immigration/ConcentricSunburstRanking.tsx
// ==========================================

"use client";

import { useState, useMemo } from "react";
import {
  ImmigrationItem,
  formatSpanishNumber,
  formatCompactSpanish,
  describeArc,
} from "./utils";
import { PieChart, Filter, Sparkles } from "lucide-react";

interface ConcentricSunburstRankingProps {
  item: ImmigrationItem;
  activeDataMap: Record<string, number>;
  totalArrivals: number;
  pinnedCountryId: string | null;
  setPinnedCountryId: (cId: string | null) => void;
  hoveredCountryId: string | null;
  setHoveredCountryId: (cId: string | null) => void;
  selectedTimeframeLabel: string;
}

const BLOCK_COLORS: Record<string, string> = {
  "america-hispanohablante": "#2563EB", // Blue
  "america-no-hispanohablante": "#7C3AED", // Purple
  europa: "#0891B2", // Cyan
  africa: "#059669", // Emerald
  asia: "#D97706", // Amber
  oceania: "#64748B", // Slate
};

const SHORT_BLOCK_NAMES: Record<string, string> = {
  "america-hispanohablante": "América Hisp.",
  "america-no-hispanohablante": "América No Hisp.",
  europa: "Europa",
  africa: "África",
  asia: "Asia",
  oceania: "Oceanía",
};

function truncateCountryName(name: string, maxLen = 11): string {
  if (name.length <= maxLen) return name;
  return name.slice(0, maxLen - 1).trim() + "…";
}

export default function ConcentricSunburstRanking({
  item,
  activeDataMap,
  totalArrivals,
  pinnedCountryId,
  setPinnedCountryId,
  hoveredCountryId,
  setHoveredCountryId,
  selectedTimeframeLabel,
}: ConcentricSunburstRankingProps) {
  const [activeDrillBlockId, setActiveDrillBlockId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [hoveredSector, setHoveredSector] = useState<{
    type: "block" | "country";
    name: string;
    value: number;
    globalPct: number;
    parentPct?: number;
    color: string;
    id: string;
  } | null>(null);

  // Compute hierarchical sectors for Sunburst / Concentric Rings
  const { blockSectors, countrySectors, blockRankings } = useMemo(() => {
    const totalGlobal = totalArrivals || 1;
    const cx = 240;
    const cy = 240;
    const rInBlock = 80;
    const rOutBlock = 145;
    const rInCountry = 152;
    const rOutCountry = 220;

    let currentAngle = -Math.PI / 2;

    const blocksToRender = activeDrillBlockId
      ? item.blocks.filter((b) => b.id === activeDrillBlockId)
      : item.blocks;

    const blockTotals: Array<{
      id: string;
      name: string;
      color: string;
      total: number;
      countries: Array<{ id: string; name: string; value: number }>;
    }> = [];

    let filteredTotal = 0;
    blocksToRender.forEach((block) => {
      let bSum = 0;
      const cList: Array<{ id: string; name: string; value: number }> = [];

      block.countries.forEach((c) => {
        const val = activeDataMap[c.id] || 0;
        if (val > 0) {
          bSum += val;
          cList.push({ id: c.id, name: c.name, value: val });
        }
      });

      cList.sort((a, b) => b.value - a.value);
      if (bSum > 0) {
        filteredTotal += bSum;
        blockTotals.push({
          id: block.id,
          name: block.name,
          color: BLOCK_COLORS[block.id] || "#64748B",
          total: bSum,
          countries: cList,
        });
      }
    });

    blockTotals.sort((a, b) => b.total - a.total);

    const bSectors: any[] = [];
    const cSectors: any[] = [];

    blockTotals.forEach((block) => {
      const angleSpan = activeDrillBlockId
        ? 2 * Math.PI
        : (block.total / (filteredTotal || 1)) * (2 * Math.PI);
      const startAngle = currentAngle;
      const endAngle = currentAngle + angleSpan;

      const pathD = describeArc(cx, cy, rInBlock, rOutBlock, startAngle, endAngle);
      const globalPct = (block.total / totalGlobal) * 100;

      bSectors.push({
        id: block.id,
        name: block.name,
        shortName: SHORT_BLOCK_NAMES[block.id] || block.name,
        color: block.color,
        value: block.total,
        globalPct,
        startAngle,
        endAngle,
        angleSpan,
        pathD,
      });

      let cCurrentAngle = startAngle;
      block.countries.forEach((country) => {
        const blockBaseTotal = block.total || 1;
        const cAngleSpan = activeDrillBlockId
          ? (country.value / blockBaseTotal) * (2 * Math.PI)
          : (country.value / blockBaseTotal) * angleSpan;
        const cStartAngle = cCurrentAngle;
        const cEndAngle = cCurrentAngle + cAngleSpan;

        const cPathD = describeArc(cx, cy, rInCountry, rOutCountry, cStartAngle, cEndAngle);
        const cGlobalPct = (country.value / totalGlobal) * 100;
        const cParentPct = (country.value / block.total) * 100;

        cSectors.push({
          id: country.id,
          name: country.name,
          displayName: truncateCountryName(country.name, 11),
          blockId: block.id,
          blockName: block.name,
          color: block.color,
          value: country.value,
          globalPct: cGlobalPct,
          parentPct: cParentPct,
          startAngle: cStartAngle,
          endAngle: cEndAngle,
          angleSpan: cAngleSpan,
          pathD: cPathD,
        });

        cCurrentAngle = cEndAngle;
      });

      if (!activeDrillBlockId) {
        currentAngle = endAngle;
      }
    });

    return { blockSectors: bSectors, countrySectors: cSectors, blockRankings: blockTotals };
  }, [item, activeDataMap, totalArrivals, activeDrillBlockId]);

  return (
    <div className="bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded-2xl p-6 text-white shadow-xl space-y-6">
      {/* Header & Drilldown Reset */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4 border-b border-slate-800 pb-4">
        <div>
          <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-white flex items-center gap-2">
            <PieChart className="w-4 h-4 text-purple-400" />
            Distribución Concéntrica (Anillo 1: Continentes → Anillo 2: Países)
          </h3>
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 mt-0.5">
            {selectedTimeframeLabel} • Visualización jerárquica de 360° del flujo migratorio hacia España.
          </p>
        </div>

        {activeDrillBlockId && (
          <button
            onClick={() => setActiveDrillBlockId(null)}
            className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-300 border border-amber-500/40 hover:bg-amber-500/30 transition-colors flex items-center gap-1.5 self-start sm:self-auto"
          >
            <Filter className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            Mostrar todos los continentes
          </button>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Continents Legend Bar */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-2 bg-slate-800/80 p-3 rounded-xl border border-slate-700/60 text-xs">
        <span className="font-semibold text-slate-400 flex items-center gap-1 mr-2">
          <Sparkles className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-purple-400" />
          Continentes (Anillo 1):
        </span>
        {blockRankings.map((block) => (
          <button
            key={block.id}
            onClick={() => setActiveDrillBlockId(activeDrillBlockId === block.id ? null : block.id)}
            className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1 rounded-lg border transition-all ${
              activeDrillBlockId === block.id
                ? "bg-slate-900 border-blue-500 ring-1 ring-blue-500 font-bold"
                : "bg-slate-900/60 border-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-900"
            }`}
          >
            <span className="w-3 h-3 rounded-full flex-shrink-0" style={{ backgroundColor: block.color }} />
            <span className="text-white">{block.name}</span>
            <span className="text-slate-400 font-mono text-[10px]">
              ({((block.total / (totalArrivals || 1)) * 100).toFixed(1)}%)
            </span>
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* Sunburst Centered Canvas */}
      <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center relative">
        <div className="relative w-full max-w-[460px] aspect-square">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 480 480" className="w-full h-full overflow-visible">
            {/* Inner Ring (Continents) */}
            {blockSectors.map((sector) => {
              const isHovered = hoveredSector?.id === sector.id;
              const isDrilled = activeDrillBlockId === sector.id;
              const showLabel = sector.angleSpan >= 0.38;

              const rMidBlock = (80 + 145) / 2; // 112.5
              const midAngle = (sector.startAngle + sector.endAngle) / 2;
              const x = 240 + rMidBlock * Math.cos(midAngle);
              const y = 240 + rMidBlock * Math.sin(midAngle);

              return (
                <g key={`block-group-${sector.id}`}>
                  <path
                    d={sector.pathD}
                    fill={sector.color}
                    fillOpacity={isHovered || isDrilled ? 1 : 0.88}
                    stroke="#060913"
                    strokeWidth="2.5"
                    className="cursor-pointer transition-all duration-200 hover:scale-[1.015] origin-center"
                    onMouseEnter={() =>
                      setHoveredSector({
                        type: "block",
                        name: sector.name,
                        value: sector.value,
                        globalPct: sector.globalPct,
                        color: sector.color,
                        id: sector.id,
                      })
                    }
                    onMouseLeave={() => setHoveredSector(null)}
                    onClick={() =>
                      setActiveDrillBlockId(activeDrillBlockId === sector.id ? null : sector.id)
                    }
                  >
                    <title>
                      {sector.name}: {formatSpanishNumber(sector.value)} ({sector.globalPct.toFixed(1)}%)
                    </title>
                  </path>

                  {showLabel && (
                    <text
                      x={x}
                      y={y}
                      textAnchor="middle"
                      dominantBaseline="middle"
                      className="text-[10px] font-bold fill-white select-none pointer-events-none"
                      aria-hidden="true"
                      stroke="#060913"
                      strokeWidth="2.5"
                      strokeOpacity="0.8"
                      paint-order="stroke fill"
                    >
                      <tspan x={x} dy="-0.4em">{sector.shortName}</tspan>
                      <tspan x={x} dy="1.1em">{sector.globalPct.toFixed(1)}%</tspan>
                    </text>
                  )}
                </g>
              );
            })}

            {/* Outer Ring (Countries) */}
            {countrySectors.map((sector) => {
              const isHovered = hoveredSector?.id === sector.id || hoveredCountryId === sector.id;
              const isPinned = pinnedCountryId === sector.id;
              const showLabel = sector.angleSpan >= 0.21;

              const rMidCountry = (152 + 220) / 2; // 186
              const midAngle = (sector.startAngle + sector.endAngle) / 2;
              const x = 240 + rMidCountry * Math.cos(midAngle);
              const y = 240 + rMidCountry * Math.sin(midAngle);

              const angleDeg = (midAngle * 180) / Math.PI;
              const isLeftHalf = Math.cos(midAngle) < 0;
              const textRotation = isLeftHalf ? angleDeg + 180 : angleDeg;

              const hasActiveSelection = hoveredCountryId !== null || pinnedCountryId !== null || hoveredSector !== null;
              const isSelected = isHovered || isPinned;

              return (
                <g key={`country-group-${sector.id}`}>
                  <path
                    d={sector.pathD}
                    fill={sector.color}
                    fillOpacity={isHovered || isPinned ? 1 : 0.8}
                    stroke="#060913"
                    strokeWidth="1.5"
                    className="cursor-pointer transition-all duration-200 hover:scale-[1.02] origin-center"
                    onMouseEnter={() => {
                      setHoveredSector({
                        type: "country",
                        name: sector.name,
                        value: sector.value,
                        globalPct: sector.globalPct,
                        parentPct: sector.parentPct,
                        color: sector.color,
                        id: sector.id,
                      });
                      setHoveredCountryId(sector.id);
                    }}
                    onMouseLeave={() => {
                      setHoveredSector(null);
                      setHoveredCountryId(null);
                    }}
                    onClick={() =>
                      setPinnedCountryId(pinnedCountryId === sector.id ? null : sector.id)
                    }
                  >
                    <title>
                      {sector.name}: {formatSpanishNumber(sector.value)} ({sector.globalPct.toFixed(1)}% del total, {sector.parentPct.toFixed(1)}% de {sector.blockName})
                    </title>
                  </path>

                  {showLabel && (
                    <text
                      x={x}
                      y={y}
                      textAnchor="middle"
                      dominantBaseline="middle"
                      transform={`rotate(${textRotation}, ${x}, ${y})`}
                      className={`text-[10px] transition-opacity duration-200 select-none pointer-events-none ${
                        isSelected
                          ? "opacity-100 font-extrabold"
                          : hasActiveSelection
                          ? "opacity-45"
                          : "opacity-90 font-bold"
                      } fill-white`}
                      aria-hidden="true"
                      stroke="#060913"
                      strokeWidth="2.5"
                      strokeOpacity="0.8"
                      paint-order="stroke fill"
                    >
                      {sector.displayName} {sector.globalPct.toFixed(0)}%
                    </text>
                  )}
                </g>
              );
            })}

            {/* Center Circle */}
            <circle cx="240" cy="240" r="70" fill="#060913" className="drop-shadow-lg" />
            <g className="text-center pointer-events-none">
              <text
                x="240"
                y="220"
                textAnchor="middle"
                className="text-[11px] font-bold fill-slate-400 uppercase tracking-widest"
              >
                Total Global
              </text>
              <text
                x="240"
                y="248"
                textAnchor="middle"
                className="text-lg font-black fill-white font-mono"
              >
                {formatCompactSpanish(totalArrivals)}
              </text>
              <text
                x="240"
                y="266"
                textAnchor="middle"
                className="text-[11px] font-semibold fill-slate-400"
              >
                personas
              </text>
            </g>
          </svg>
        </div>

        {/* Hover Tooltip Card */}
        <div className="h-14 mt-4 flex items-center justify-center">
          {hoveredSector ? (
            <div className="bg-slate-800 text-white rounded-xl px-4 py-2 text-center text-xs shadow-lg flex items-center gap-2 border border-slate-700">
              <span className="w-3 h-3 rounded-full flex-shrink-0" style={{ backgroundColor: hoveredSector.color }} />
              <div>
                <span className="font-bold">{hoveredSector.name}: </span>
                <span className="font-mono text-yellow-300 font-semibold">
                  {formatSpanishNumber(hoveredSector.value)} personas
                </span>
                <span className="text-slate-400 ml-1.5 font-mono">
                  ({hoveredSector.globalPct.toFixed(1)}% del total
                  {hoveredSector.parentPct !== undefined ? `, ${hoveredSector.parentPct.toFixed(1)}% del bloque` : ""})
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <span className="text-xs text-slate-500 italic">
              Pasa el cursor sobre los anillos concéntricos o haz clic en un continente para filtrar.
            </span>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}


// ==========================================
// FILE: components/detail/immigration/ContinentCountrySplitView.tsx
// ==========================================

"use client";

import { useState, useMemo } from "react";
import {
  ImmigrationItem,
  formatSpanishNumber,
  formatCompactSpanish,
  describeArc,
} from "./utils";
import { PieChart, Search, X, Sparkles } from "lucide-react";
import { t, Lang } from "@/lib/i18n";

interface ContinentCountrySplitViewProps {
  item: ImmigrationItem;
  activeDataMap: Record<string, number>;
  totalArrivals: number;
  pinnedCountryId: string | null;
  setPinnedCountryId: (cId: string | null) => void;
  hoveredCountryId: string | null;
  setHoveredCountryId: (cId: string | null) => void;
  selectedTimeframeLabel: string;
  lang?: Lang;
}

const BLOCK_COLORS: Record<string, string> = {
  "america-hispanohablante": "#2563EB", // Blue
  "america-no-hispanohablante": "#7C3AED", // Purple
  europa: "#0891B2", // Cyan
  africa: "#059669", // Emerald
  asia: "#D97706", // Amber
  oceania: "#64748B", // Slate
};

const BLOCK_NAMES_MAP: Record<string, string> = {
  "america-hispanohablante": "América (Hispanohablante)",
  "america-no-hispanohablante": "América (No Hispanohablante)",
  europa: "Europa",
  africa: "África",
  asia: "Asia",
  oceania: "Oceanía",
};

export default function ContinentCountrySplitView({
  item,
  activeDataMap,
  totalArrivals,
  pinnedCountryId,
  setPinnedCountryId,
  hoveredCountryId,
  setHoveredCountryId,
  selectedTimeframeLabel,
  lang = "es",
}: ContinentCountrySplitViewProps) {
  const [activeBlockFilter, setActiveBlockFilter] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState<string>("");
  const [hoveredSectorId, setHoveredSectorId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // 1. Process block and country data
  const { blockSectors, allCountriesList } = useMemo(() => {
    const totalGlobal = totalArrivals || 1;
    let currentAngle = -Math.PI / 2;

    const blockTotals: Array<{
      id: string;
      name: string;
      color: string;
      total: number;
      countries: Array<{ id: string; name: string; value: number; globalPct: number; parentPct: number }>;
    }> = [];

    let filteredTotal = 0;
    item.blocks.forEach((block) => {
      let bSum = 0;
      const cList: Array<{ id: string; name: string; value: number; globalPct: number; parentPct: number }> = [];

      block.countries.forEach((c) => {
        const val = activeDataMap[c.id] || 0;
        if (val > 0) {
          bSum += val;
        }
      });

      block.countries.forEach((c) => {
        // Exclude residual "Rest of..." aggregate categories from individual country ranking list
        if (c.id.startsWith("resto-de-")) return;

        const val = activeDataMap[c.id] || 0;
        if (val > 0) {
          const gPct = (val / totalGlobal) * 100;
          const pPct = bSum > 0 ? (val / bSum) * 100 : 0;
          cList.push({ id: c.id, name: c.name, value: val, globalPct: gPct, parentPct: pPct });
        }
      });

      cList.sort((a, b) => b.value - a.value);
      if (bSum > 0) {
        filteredTotal += bSum;
        blockTotals.push({
          id: block.id,
          name: BLOCK_NAMES_MAP[block.id] || block.name,
          color: BLOCK_COLORS[block.id] || "#64748B",
          total: bSum,
          countries: cList,
        });
      }
    });

    blockTotals.sort((a, b) => b.total - a.total);

    const bSectors: any[] = [];
    const flatCountries: Array<{
      id: string;
      name: string;
      value: number;
      globalPct: number;
      parentPct: number;
      blockId: string;
      blockName: string;
      color: string;
    }> = [];

    blockTotals.forEach((block) => {
      const angleSpan = (block.total / (filteredTotal || 1)) * (2 * Math.PI);
      const startAngle = currentAngle;
      const endAngle = currentAngle + angleSpan;
      const pathD = describeArc(160, 160, 72, 118, startAngle, endAngle);
      const globalPct = (block.total / totalGlobal) * 100;

      bSectors.push({
        id: block.id,
        name: block.name,
        color: block.color,
        value: block.total,
        globalPct,
        startAngle,
        endAngle,
        angleSpan,
        pathD,
      });

      block.countries.forEach((c) => {
        if (c.id.startsWith("resto-de-")) return;
        flatCountries.push({
          ...c,
          blockId: block.id,
          blockName: block.name,
          color: block.color,
        });
      });

      currentAngle = endAngle;
    });

    flatCountries.sort((a, b) => b.value - a.value);

    return { blockSectors: bSectors, allCountriesList: flatCountries };
  }, [item, activeDataMap, totalArrivals]);

  // 2. Filtered countries for the right panel (showing all individual countries without residual aggregate groups)
  const { visibleCountries, maxCountryVal } = useMemo(() => {
    let filtered = allCountriesList;

    if (activeBlockFilter) {
      filtered = filtered.filter((c) => c.blockId === activeBlockFilter);
    }

    if (searchQuery.trim()) {
      const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase().trim();
      filtered = filtered.filter((c) => c.name.toLowerCase().includes(q));
    }

    const mVal = filtered[0]?.value || 1;

    return {
      visibleCountries: filtered,
      maxCountryVal: mVal,
    };
  }, [allCountriesList, activeBlockFilter, searchQuery]);

  const formatPct = (val: number) => {
    const formatted = val.toFixed(1);
    return lang === "es" ? formatted.replace(".", ",") + "%" : formatted + "%";
  };

  return (
    <div className="bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded-2xl p-5 sm:p-6 text-white shadow-xl space-y-6">
      {/* Top Header & Timeframe / Filters Bar */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4 border-b border-slate-800 pb-4">
        <div>
          <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-white flex items-center gap-2">
            <PieChart className="w-4 h-4 text-purple-400" />
            {lang === "en" ? "Continent Donut & Ranked Countries" : "Donut de Continentes y Ranking de Países"}
          </h3>
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 mt-0.5">
            {selectedTimeframeLabel} • {lang === "en" ? "Interactive geographic breakdown and detailed origin ranking." : "Desglose geográfico interactivo y ranking detallado de origen."}
          </p>
        </div>

        {(activeBlockFilter || searchQuery) && (
          <button
            onClick={() => {
              setActiveBlockFilter(null);
              setSearchQuery("");
            }}
            className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold bg-blue-500/20 text-blue-300 border border-blue-500/40 hover:bg-blue-500/30 transition-colors flex items-center gap-1.5 self-start sm:self-auto"
          >
            <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            {t("resetFilter", lang)}
          </button>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Responsive 2-Column Split Dashboard (Grid 12: 5 left, 7 right) */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 items-start">
        
        {/* LEFT PANEL: Single-Ring Continent Donut + Vertical Breakdown List (5 columns) */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-5 bg-slate-950/40 border border-slate-800/80 rounded-2xl p-4 flex flex-col space-y-4">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-800 pb-2">
            <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-300 uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <Sparkles className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-purple-400" />
              {t("breakdownContinents", lang)}
            </span>
            {activeBlockFilter && (
              <span className="text-[10px] bg-purple-500/20 text-purple-300 px-2 py-0.5 rounded border border-purple-500/30 font-semibold">
                {BLOCK_NAMES_MAP[activeBlockFilter]}
              </span>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Clean Donut with zero overflow */}
          <div className="relative w-full max-w-[260px] aspect-square mx-auto flex items-center justify-center">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 320 320" className="w-full h-full">
              {blockSectors.map((sector) => {
                const isActive = activeBlockFilter === sector.id;
                const isHovered = hoveredSectorId === sector.id;
                const hasActiveFilter = activeBlockFilter !== null;

                let opacity = 0.9;
                if (hasActiveFilter && !isActive) opacity = 0.25;
                if (isHovered) opacity = 1;

                return (
                  <path
                    key={`donut-${sector.id}`}
                    d={sector.pathD}
                    fill={sector.color}
                    fillOpacity={opacity}
                    stroke="#090d16"
                    strokeWidth="2.5"
                    className="cursor-pointer transition-all duration-200 hover:scale-[1.015] origin-center"
                    onClick={() =>
                      setActiveBlockFilter(activeBlockFilter === sector.id ? null : sector.id)
                    }
                    onMouseEnter={() => setHoveredSectorId(sector.id)}
                    onMouseLeave={() => setHoveredSectorId(null)}
                  >
                    <title>
                      {sector.name}: {formatSpanishNumber(sector.value)} {t("pers", lang)} ({sector.globalPct.toFixed(1)}%)
                    </title>
                  </path>
                );
              })}

              {/* Center KPI Readout */}
              <circle cx="160" cy="160" r="62" fill="#060913" className="drop-shadow-md" />
              <text
                x="160"
                y="142"
                textAnchor="middle"
                className="text-[10px] font-bold fill-slate-400 uppercase tracking-widest"
              >
                {t("totalGlobal", lang)}
              </text>
              <text
                x="160"
                y="168"
                textAnchor="middle"
                className="text-xl font-black fill-white font-mono"
              >
                {formatCompactSpanish(totalArrivals)}
              </text>
              <text
                x="160"
                y="185"
                textAnchor="middle"
                className="text-[10px] font-semibold fill-slate-400"
              >
                {t("people", lang)}
              </text>
            </svg>
          </div>

          {/* Interactive Vertical Breakdown List below Donut (fills dead space & acts as clean filter) */}
          <div className="space-y-1.5 pt-2 border-t border-slate-800/80">
            {blockSectors.map((sector) => {
              const isActive = activeBlockFilter === sector.id;
              const isHovered = hoveredSectorId === sector.id;

              return (
                <div
                  key={`block-row-${sector.id}`}
                  onClick={() => setActiveBlockFilter(activeBlockFilter === sector.id ? null : sector.id)}
                  onMouseEnter={() => setHoveredSectorId(sector.id)}
                  onMouseLeave={() => setHoveredSectorId(null)}
                  className={`p-2 rounded-xl border transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center justify-between text-xs ${
                    isActive
                      ? "bg-purple-950/40 border-purple-500/80 ring-1 ring-purple-500/50 font-bold"
                      : isHovered
                      ? "bg-slate-900 border-slate-700"
                      : "bg-slate-900/40 border-slate-800 hover:border-slate-700"
                  }`}
                >
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 truncate">
                    <span className="w-3 h-3 rounded-full flex-shrink-0" style={{ backgroundColor: sector.color }} />
                    <span className="text-white truncate">{sector.name}</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 font-mono flex-shrink-0">
                    <span className="text-slate-400 text-[11px]">{formatSpanishNumber(sector.value)} {t("pers", lang)}</span>
                    <span className="text-white font-bold w-12 text-right">{formatPct(sector.globalPct)}</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* RIGHT PANEL: Ranked Countries (7 columns) */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-7 bg-slate-950/40 border border-slate-800/80 rounded-2xl p-4 flex flex-col space-y-4">
          
          {/* Header & Search Bar */}
          <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 border-b border-slate-800 pb-3">
            <div>
              <h4 className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-300 uppercase tracking-wider">
                {t("originCountriesRanking", lang)}
              </h4>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 mt-0.5">
                {visibleCountries.length} {lang === "en" ? "countries listed" : "países listados"}
                {activeBlockFilter ? ` • ${BLOCK_NAMES_MAP[activeBlockFilter]}` : ""}
              </p>
            </div>

            {/* Search Input */}
            <div className="relative w-full sm:w-56">
              <Search className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400 absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2" />
              <input
                type="text"
                placeholder={t("searchCountry", lang)}
                value={searchQuery}
                onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700 rounded-lg pl-9 pr-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-white placeholder-slate-500 focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-500"
              />
              {searchQuery && (
                <button
                  onClick={() => setSearchQuery("")}
                  className="absolute right-2.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400 hover:text-white"
                >
                  <X className="w-3 h-3" />
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Country Ranking Rows Scrollable Container (increased height to max-h-[520px]) */}
          <div className="space-y-2 max-h-[520px] overflow-y-auto pr-1">
            {visibleCountries.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="text-center py-12 text-slate-500 text-xs italic">
                {lang === "en" ? "No countries match current filter or search." : "Ningún país coincide con el filtro o búsqueda actual."}
              </div>
            ) : (
              visibleCountries.map((country, idx) => {
                const isHovered = hoveredCountryId === country.id;
                const isPinned = pinnedCountryId === country.id;
                const barWidthPct = Math.max(4, Math.min(100, (country.value / (maxCountryVal || 1)) * 100));

                return (
                  <div
                    key={country.id}
                    onMouseEnter={() => setHoveredCountryId(country.id)}
                    onMouseLeave={() => setHoveredCountryId(null)}
                    onClick={() => setPinnedCountryId(pinnedCountryId === country.id ? null : country.id)}
                    className={`py-2.5 px-3.5 rounded-xl border transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center justify-between gap-3 ${
                      isPinned
                        ? "bg-blue-950/60 border-blue-500 ring-1 ring-blue-500 shadow-md"
                        : isHovered
                        ? "bg-slate-900/90 border-slate-700"
                        : "bg-slate-900/50 border-slate-800/80 hover:border-slate-700"
                    }`}
                  >
                    {/* Left: Rank, Name, Headcount */}
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-3 min-w-[170px] sm:min-w-[200px] truncate">
                      <span className="text-xs font-mono font-bold text-slate-500 w-5 flex-shrink-0">
                        #{idx + 1}
                      </span>
                      <div className="truncate">
                        <div className="text-xs font-bold text-white truncate">{country.name}</div>
                        <div className="text-[11px] font-mono text-slate-400">
                          {formatSpanishNumber(country.value)} {t("pers", lang)}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* Center: Proportional Progress Bar colored by continent */}
                    <div className="flex-1 hidden sm:block px-2">
                      <div className="w-full bg-slate-800 rounded-full h-2 overflow-hidden">
                        <div
                          className="h-full rounded-full transition-all duration-300"
                          style={{
                            width: `${barWidthPct}%`,
                            backgroundColor: country.color,
                          }}
                        />
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* Right: Tabular Percentage */}
                    <div className="text-right flex-shrink-0 min-w-[60px]">
                      <span className="text-xs font-mono font-bold text-white tabular-nums">
                        {formatPct(country.globalPct)}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                );
              })
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

      </div>
    </div>
  );
}


// ==========================================
// FILE: components/detail/immigration/HorizontalBarRanking.tsx
// ==========================================

"use client";

import { useState, useMemo } from "react";
import {
  ImmigrationItem,
  COUNTRY_GEO_MAP,
  formatSpanishNumber,
  formatCompactSpanish,
} from "./utils";
import { BarChart3, Globe2 } from "lucide-react";

interface HorizontalBarRankingProps {
  activeDataMap: Record<string, number>;
  totalArrivals: number;
  pinnedCountryId: string | null;
  setPinnedCountryId: (cId: string | null) => void;
  hoveredCountryId: string | null;
  setHoveredCountryId: (cId: string | null) => void;
}

const BLOCK_COLORS: Record<string, { name: string; bar: string; badge: string }> = {
  "america-hispanohablante": {
    name: "América Hispanohablante",
    bar: "#2563EB",
    badge: "bg-blue-950 text-blue-300 border-blue-800",
  },
  "america-no-hispanohablante": {
    name: "América No Hispanohablante",
    bar: "#7C3AED",
    badge: "bg-purple-950 text-purple-300 border-purple-800",
  },
  europa: {
    name: "Europa",
    bar: "#0891B2",
    badge: "bg-cyan-950 text-cyan-300 border-cyan-800",
  },
  africa: {
    name: "África",
    bar: "#059669",
    badge: "bg-emerald-950 text-emerald-300 border-emerald-800",
  },
  asia: {
    name: "Asia",
    bar: "#D97706",
    badge: "bg-amber-950 text-amber-300 border-amber-800",
  },
  oceania: {
    name: "Oceanía",
    bar: "#64748B",
    badge: "bg-slate-800 text-slate-300 border-slate-700",
  },
};

export default function HorizontalBarRanking({
  activeDataMap,
  totalArrivals,
  pinnedCountryId,
  setPinnedCountryId,
  hoveredCountryId,
  setHoveredCountryId,
}: HorizontalBarRankingProps) {
  const rankedItems = useMemo(() => {
    return Object.entries(activeDataMap)
      .map(([cId, val]) => {
        const geo = COUNTRY_GEO_MAP[cId];
        const pct = totalArrivals > 0 ? (val / totalArrivals) * 100 : 0;
        const bId = geo?.blockId || "oceania";
        return {
          id: cId,
          name: geo?.name || cId,
          blockId: bId,
          blockName: geo?.blockName || "Otros",
          value: val,
          pct,
          style: BLOCK_COLORS[bId] || BLOCK_COLORS.oceania,
        };
      })
      .filter((item) => item.value > 0)
      .sort((a, b) => b.value - a.value);
  }, [activeDataMap, totalArrivals]);

  const maxVal = rankedItems[0]?.value || 1;

  return (
    <div className="bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded-2xl p-6 text-white shadow-xl space-y-5">
      {/* Header & Legend */}
      <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-4 border-b border-slate-800 pb-4">
        <div>
          <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-white flex items-center gap-2">
            <BarChart3 className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-400" />
            Ranking de Países de Origen por Volumen e Intensidad Geográfica
          </h3>
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 mt-0.5">
            Distribución proporcional de la inmigración por procedencia y región continental/lingüística.
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* Compact Legend */}
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-[11px]">
          {Object.entries(BLOCK_COLORS).map(([bId, cfg]) => (
            <div key={bId} className="flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-slate-800/80 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg border border-slate-700/60">
              <span className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full" style={{ backgroundColor: cfg.bar }} />
              <span className="text-slate-300 font-medium">{cfg.name}</span>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Horizontal Bars Container */}
      <div className="space-y-2.5 max-h-[480px] overflow-y-auto pr-2">
        {rankedItems.map((item, idx) => {
          const isPinned = pinnedCountryId === item.id;
          const isHovered = hoveredCountryId === item.id;
          const widthPct = (item.value / maxVal) * 100;

          return (
            <div
              key={item.id}
              onMouseEnter={() => setHoveredCountryId(item.id)}
              onMouseLeave={() => setHoveredCountryId(null)}
              onClick={() => setPinnedCountryId(isPinned ? null : item.id)}
              className={`p-3 rounded-xl border transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                isPinned
                  ? "bg-blue-950/80 border-blue-500 ring-1 ring-blue-500 shadow-md"
                  : isHovered
                  ? "bg-slate-800/90 border-slate-700"
                  : "bg-slate-800/40 border-slate-800/80 hover:bg-slate-800/70"
              }`}
            >
              <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-2 text-xs mb-1.5">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                  <span className="font-mono text-slate-500 text-[11px] font-bold w-5">
                    #{idx + 1}
                  </span>
                  <span className="font-bold text-white text-sm">
                    {item.name}
                  </span>
                  <span className={`text-[10px] font-semibold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md border ${item.style.badge}`}>
                    {item.blockName}
                  </span>
                </div>

                <div className="flex items-center gap-3 font-mono font-bold">
                  <span className="text-yellow-300 text-sm">
                    {formatSpanishNumber(item.value)} pers.
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-sky-300 text-xs min-w-[45px] text-right">
                    {item.pct.toFixed(1)}%
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Horizontal Proportion Bar */}
              <div className="w-full bg-slate-800 rounded-full h-2.5 overflow-hidden">
                <div
                  className="h-full rounded-full transition-all duration-300 shadow-xs"
                  style={{
                    width: `${Math.max(2, widthPct)}%`,
                    backgroundColor: item.style.bar,
                  }}
                />
              </div>
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// FILE: components/detail/immigration/ImmigrationView.tsx
// ==========================================

"use client";

import { useState, useMemo, useEffect } from "react";
import { ImmigrationItem, AnnualBlock } from "@/types";
import WebGisChronoArcs from "./WebGisChronoArcs";
import TimelineScrubber from "./TimelineScrubber";
import ContinentCountrySplitView from "./ContinentCountrySplitView";
import { Lang } from "@/lib/i18n";

type TimeframeMode = "single" | "range";
type YearRange = [string, string];

const PLAYBACK_INTERVAL_MS = 900;
const DEFAULT_FALLBACK_END_YEAR = "2024";
const DEFAULT_FALLBACK_START_YEAR = "2019";
const DEFAULT_RANGE_SPAN = 5;

interface ImmigrationViewProps {
  item: ImmigrationItem;
  lang?: Lang;
}

interface AggregatedMetrics {
  activeDataMap: Record<string, number>;
  totalArrivals: number;
  timeframeLabel: string;
}

function aggregateAnnualBlocks(blocks: AnnualBlock[]): {
  dataMap: Record<string, number>;
  total: number;
} {
  const dataMap: Record<string, number> = {};
  let total = 0;

  for (const annualBlock of blocks) {
    total += annualBlock.total;
    for (const regionalBlock of Object.values(annualBlock.blocks)) {
      for (const [countryId, volume] of Object.entries(regionalBlock.countries)) {
        dataMap[countryId] = (dataMap[countryId] ?? 0) + volume;
      }
    }
  }

  return { dataMap, total };
}

export default function ImmigrationView({ item, lang = "es" }: ImmigrationViewProps) {
  const years = useMemo(
    () => item.annualBlocks.map((block) => block.year),
    [item.annualBlocks]
  );

  const latestYear = years.at(-1) ?? DEFAULT_FALLBACK_END_YEAR;
  const defaultRangeStart =
    years[Math.max(0, years.length - DEFAULT_RANGE_SPAN)] ?? DEFAULT_FALLBACK_START_YEAR;

  const [selectedYear, setSelectedYear] = useState<string>(latestYear);
  const [yearRange, setYearRange] = useState<YearRange>([defaultRangeStart, latestYear]);
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<TimeframeMode>("single");
  const [isPlaying, setIsPlaying] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const [hoveredCountryId, setHoveredCountryId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [pinnedCountryId, setPinnedCountryId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState<string>("");
  const [selectedBlockFilter, setSelectedBlockFilter] = useState<string>("");
  const [minVolumeThreshold, setMinVolumeThreshold] = useState<number>(0);

  // Stop playback when reaching the end of the timeline without triggering impure state updates inside setSelectedYear
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isPlaying || mode !== "single") return;

    const currentIdx = years.indexOf(selectedYear);
    if (currentIdx === -1 || currentIdx >= years.length - 1) {
      setIsPlaying(false);
      return;
    }

    const timer = window.setTimeout(() => {
      setSelectedYear(years[currentIdx + 1]);
    }, PLAYBACK_INTERVAL_MS);

    return () => window.clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [isPlaying, mode, selectedYear, years]);

  const { activeDataMap, totalArrivals, timeframeLabel } = useMemo<AggregatedMetrics>(() => {
    if (mode === "single") {
      const targetBlock = item.annualBlocks.find((d) => d.year === selectedYear);
      const { dataMap, total } = aggregateAnnualBlocks(targetBlock ? [targetBlock] : []);
      return {
        activeDataMap: dataMap,
        totalArrivals: total,
        timeframeLabel: `Año ${selectedYear}`,
      };
    }

    const startIdx = years.indexOf(yearRange[0]);
    const endIdx = years.indexOf(yearRange[1]);

    const matchingBlocks =
      startIdx !== -1 && endIdx !== -1
        ? item.annualBlocks.filter((ab) => {
            const yIdx = years.indexOf(ab.year);
            return yIdx >= Math.min(startIdx, endIdx) && yIdx <= Math.max(startIdx, endIdx);
          })
        : [];

    const { dataMap, total } = aggregateAnnualBlocks(matchingBlocks);

    return {
      activeDataMap: dataMap,
      totalArrivals: total,
      timeframeLabel: `Rango ${yearRange[0]}–${yearRange[1]}`,
    };
  }, [item.annualBlocks, mode, selectedYear, yearRange, years]);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Top Timeline Scrubber (Placed right at the top) */}
      <TimelineScrubber
        years={years}
        selectedYear={selectedYear}
        setSelectedYear={setSelectedYear}
        yearRange={yearRange}
        setYearRange={setYearRange}
        mode={mode}
        setMode={setMode}
        isPlaying={isPlaying}
        setIsPlaying={setIsPlaying}
      />

      {/* 1. Map Canvas */}
      <div className="w-full">
        <WebGisChronoArcs
          timeframeLabel={timeframeLabel}
          activeDataMap={activeDataMap}
          totalArrivals={totalArrivals}
          hoveredCountryId={hoveredCountryId}
          setHoveredCountryId={setHoveredCountryId}
          pinnedCountryId={pinnedCountryId}
          setPinnedCountryId={setPinnedCountryId}
          searchQuery={searchQuery}
          selectedBlockFilter={selectedBlockFilter}
          minVolumeThreshold={minVolumeThreshold}
        />
      </div>

      {/* 2. Continent Donut & Country Ranking Split View */}
      <ContinentCountrySplitView
        item={item}
        activeDataMap={activeDataMap}
        totalArrivals={totalArrivals}
        pinnedCountryId={pinnedCountryId}
        setPinnedCountryId={setPinnedCountryId}
        hoveredCountryId={hoveredCountryId}
        setHoveredCountryId={setHoveredCountryId}
        selectedTimeframeLabel={timeframeLabel}
        lang={lang}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useState, useMemo } from "react";
import {
  ImmigrationItem,

  Filter,
  RotateCcw,

  ChevronLeft,

  Globe,
  Sliders,
} from "lucide-react";

interface SideDataDrawerProps {
  item: ImmigrationItem;
  selectedTimeframeLabel: string;
  activeDataMap: Record<string, number>;
  totalArrivals: number;
  searchQuery: string;
  setSearchQuery: (q: string) => void;
  selectedBlockFilter: string;
  setSelectedBlockFilter: (b: string) => void;
  minVolumeThreshold: number;
  setMinVolumeThreshold: (v: number) => void;
  pinnedCountryId: string | null;
  setPinnedCountryId: (cId: string | null) => void;
  hoveredCountryId: string | null;
  setHoveredCountryId: (cId: string | null) => void;
  onResetView: () => void;
}

// Continent/Block color mapping with distinction between Hispanic & Non-Hispanic Americas
const BLOCK_COLORS: Record<string, { name: string; bg: string; text: string; bar: string }> = {
  "america-hispanohablante": {
    name: "América (Hispanohablante)",
    bg: "bg-blue-950/80",
    text: "text-blue-400",
    bar: "#2563EB",
  },
  "america-no-hispanohablante": {
    name: "América (No Hispana)",
    bg: "bg-purple-950/80",
    text: "text-purple-400",
    bar: "#7C3AED",
  },
  europa: {
    name: "Europa",
    bg: "bg-cyan-950/80",
    text: "text-cyan-400",
    bar: "#0891B2",
  },
  africa: {
    name: "África",
    bg: "bg-emerald-950/80",
    text: "text-emerald-400",
    bar: "#059669",
  },
  asia: {
    name: "Asia",
    bg: "bg-amber-950/80",
    text: "text-amber-400",
    bar: "#D97706",
  },
  oceania: {
    name: "Oceanía",
    bg: "bg-slate-800",
    text: "text-slate-400",
    bar: "#64748B",
  },
};

export default function SideDataDrawer({
  item,
  selectedTimeframeLabel,
  activeDataMap,
  totalArrivals,
  searchQuery,
  setSearchQuery,
  selectedBlockFilter,
  setSelectedBlockFilter,
  minVolumeThreshold,
  setMinVolumeThreshold,
  pinnedCountryId,
  setPinnedCountryId,
  hoveredCountryId,
  setHoveredCountryId,
  onResetView,
}: SideDataDrawerProps) {
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(true);

  // Filter and rank origin countries
  const rankedCountries = useMemo(() => {
    return Object.entries(activeDataMap)
      .map(([cId, vol]) => {
        const geo = COUNTRY_GEO_MAP[cId];
        const pct = totalArrivals > 0 ? (vol / totalArrivals) * 100 : 0;
        const bId = geo?.blockId || "oceania";
        return {
          id: cId,
          name: geo?.name || cId,
          blockId: bId,
          blockName: geo?.blockName || "Otros",
          value: vol,
          pct,
          colorInfo: BLOCK_COLORS[bId] || BLOCK_COLORS.oceania,
        };
      })
      .filter((c) => {
        if (c.value <= 0) return false;
        if (c.value < minVolumeThreshold) return false;
        if (selectedBlockFilter && c.blockId !== selectedBlockFilter) return false;
        if (
          searchQuery &&
          !c.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase())
        ) {
          return false;
        }
        return true;
      })
      .sort((a, b) => b.value - a.value);
  }, [activeDataMap, totalArrivals, searchQuery, selectedBlockFilter, minVolumeThreshold]);

  const maxRankedVal = rankedCountries[0]?.value || 1;

  return (
    <div
      className={`bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded-2xl text-white shadow-2xl flex flex-col transition-all duration-300 relative ${
        isOpen ? "w-full lg:w-96" : "w-full lg:w-12"
      }`}
    >
      {/* Toggle Button for Desktop */}
      <button
        onClick={() => setIsOpen(!isOpen)}
        className="hidden lg:flex absolute -left-3 top-6 w-6 h-6 rounded-full bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-500 text-white items-center justify-center shadow-lg z-20 transition-transform"
        title={isOpen ? "Colapsar panel" : "Expandir panel"}
      >
        {isOpen ? <ChevronRight className="w-4 h-4" /> : <ChevronLeft className="w-4 h-4" />}
      </button>

      {/* Collapsed State Icon */}
      {!isOpen && (
        <div className="hidden lg:flex flex-col items-center py-6 gap-4">
          <Globe className="w-5 h-5 text-blue-400" />
          <span className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-slate-400 [writing-mode:vertical-lr]">
            Datos de Origen
          </span>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Expanded Content Drawer */}
      {isOpen && (
        <div className="p-4 sm:p-5 flex flex-col gap-4 h-full">
          {/* Drawer Header */}
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-800 pb-3">
            <div>
              <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-white flex items-center gap-2">
                <Globe className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-400" />
                Orígenes de Inmigración
              </h3>
              <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-400">
                {selectedTimeframeLabel} • Total: {formatSpanishNumber(totalArrivals)}
              </span>
            </div>

            <button
              onClick={onResetView}
              className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-300 text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-1 transition-colors"
              title="Restablecer filtros y vista"
            >
              <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-blue-400" />
              Reset
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* Search Bar */}
          <div className="relative">
            <Search className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400 absolute left-3 top-2.5" />
            <input
              type="text"
              placeholder="Buscar país de origen..."
              value={searchQuery}
              onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full bg-slate-800/90 text-xs text-white pl-9 pr-8 py-2 rounded-xl border border-slate-700/80 focus:outline-none focus:border-blue-500 placeholder-slate-500 font-medium"
            />
            {searchQuery && (
              <button
                onClick={() => setSearchQuery("")}
                className="absolute right-2.5 top-2.5 text-slate-400 hover:text-white"
              >
                <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              </button>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Region Block Filter */}
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-slate-400 flex items-center gap-1">
              <Filter className="w-3 h-3 text-blue-400" />
              Filtrar por Región:
            </span>
            <select
              value={selectedBlockFilter}
              onChange={(e) => setSelectedBlockFilter(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full bg-slate-800 text-xs font-semibold text-white border border-slate-700 rounded-xl px-3 py-1.5 focus:outline-none focus:border-blue-500"
            >
              <option value="">Todas las regiones globales</option>
              {item.blocks.map((b) => (
                <option key={b.id} value={b.id}>
                  {b.name}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </div>

          {/* Volume Threshold Slider */}
          <div className="space-y-1">
            <div className="flex justify-between text-[11px] font-semibold text-slate-400">
              <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
                <Sliders className="w-3 h-3 text-blue-400" />
                Volumen mín.:

              <span className="font-mono text-white">
                {minVolumeThreshold > 0
                  ? `>= ${formatCompactSpanish(minVolumeThreshold)}`

            <input

// FILE: components/detail/immigration/SmallMultiplesView.tsx
